identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a top 1% Cyberpunk E-commerce experience that breaks generic templates.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Cyberpunk aesthetics with Swiss Grid precision.
Emotion First: Every interaction must feel 'electric' and 'fast'.
Content is King: Products are the heroes; the UI is the stage.
Zoom In: High-fidelity details on product cards.
Negative Space: Dark void spaces to make neon pop.
Contrast: High-contrast neon against deep black.

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise texture overlay on the entire body with opacity-5 pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-[9999].

hero_background.usage: Hero section background with heavy overlay

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts link to the <head> of index.html or import in index.css.
3. THEME: Overwrite the CSS variables in 'src/index.css' with the provided Cyberpunk palette.
4. COMPONENTS: When using Shadcn components, ALWAYS override the default styles to match the 'Glassmorphism' aesthetic defined in 'components' section. Do not use default white/black cards.
5. LAYOUT: Use the 'Tetris Grid' for the landing page. Don't just stack sections vertically.
6. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash URLs. Do not use placeholders.
7. MOTION: Apply 'fade_up' animation to all major sections on scroll.
8. GLASS: Ensure all overlays (modals, dropdowns, sticky headers) use 'backdrop-blur-xl' and 'bg-black/60' (or similar) to ensure text readability over the complex background.
9. TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients on body text.
Ensure contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1 for normal text.
Never use default scrollbars; style them to be thin and dark.
Avoid 'lorem ipsum' where possible; use realistic copy related to Digital Services (e.g., 'Boost your reach', 'Level up your game').
